forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account exists, you will receive a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, an e-mail has been sent.

reset.title: Set new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.intro: You have been invited to the tenant “{tenant}”.
invite.newAccount: Set your password to activate your account.
invite.existingAccount: You already have an account. Confirm the invitation with your existing password.
invite.name: Your name
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or has already been used.

home.noTenant: You are currently not assigned to an active tenant.

system.title: System administration
system.created: Tenant created. The invitation to the administrator has been sent.
system.confirmDeactivate: Really deactivate tenant “{name}”? Its users will no longer be able to open it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.notificationsHint: These settings apply to all your tenants.
settings.notifyAssign: E-mail when a to-do is assigned to me
settings.remindDays: Days before the due date (0 = on the due date)
settings.notifyOverdue: E-mail when a to-do becomes overdue

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.conflict: The action conflicts with existing data.
errors.csrf: Your session has expired. Please reload the page.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.invalid_credentials: E-mail address or password is wrong.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the tenant.
errors.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be removed.
errors.archived: The project is archived; its to-dos cannot be changed.
errors.invalid_assignee: This person cannot be assigned to-dos in this project.
errors.in_use: This entry is still in use (e.g. as default or cancel status).
errors.tenant_mismatch: The tenant has been switched in the meantime.

todo.title: Title
todo.readOnly: You can read and comment on this to-do, but not edit it.
todo.changedElsewhere: This to-do has been changed by someone else in the meantime. Your input is kept; saving overwrites the changed fields.

projects.title: Projects
projects.confirmArchive: Archive project “{name}”? All to-dos of the project are archived and hidden as well. Nothing is deleted; the project can be restored together with its to-dos.
projects.name: Name
projects.noMembers: Nobody is assigned to this project yet.

members.title: Users
members.confirmPseudonymize: Pseudonymize “{name}”? Name and e-mail address are permanently replaced by a pseudonym in this tenant and the person is deactivated. This cannot be undone.
members.defaultRoleHint: The default role applies to to-dos without project. Project roles are assigned under “Projects”.

statuses.name: Name
statuses.hint: The rank determines the order of the columns. Statuses of the categories “Done” and “Cancelled” are hidden by default. An empty name restores the standard label.
statuses.removeText: To-dos with this status get the selected status. The change is recorded in the history of the to-dos.

priorities.removeText: To-dos with this priority get the selected priority. The change is recorded in the history of the to-dos.

tags.name: Name
tags.confirmDelete: Delete tag “{name}”? It will be removed from all to-dos.
tags.hint: Tags are created while editing to-dos. Here they can be renamed, colored or deleted.

board.linkNotFound: The to-do was not found or you have no access to it.

quick.title: Quick capture
quick.notAllowed: You are not allowed to create to-dos in this tenant.
quick.queued: Saved offline – it will be sent automatically as soon as there is a connection.
quick.otherTenants: {n} more to-do is waiting to be sent in another tenant ({tenants}). Switch there to send it. | {n} more to-dos are waiting to be sent in other tenants ({tenants}). Switch there to send them.

offline.title: Offline
offline.text: You are seeing the last loaded state. Editing is not possible; new to-dos are stored on the device and sent automatically.
offline.pending: {n} to-do waiting to be sent | {n} to-dos waiting to be sent
offline.failed: {n} to-do could not be sent. | {n} to-dos could not be sent.
offline.readOnlyTodo: Offline copy – read-only. Comments and history are only available online.
offline.confirmLogout: {n} to-do has not been sent yet and will be lost when you sign out. Sign out anyway? | {n} to-dos have not been sent yet and will be lost when you sign out. Sign out anyway?
